Mod-Seg-SE(2) Architecture & Training Pipeline

Group Equivariant Convolutional Network (C8 / N=8 Rotations) for Robust Brain CT Segmentation
1. 2.5D Spatial Stacking Input
• Input tensor: [B, 3, 256, 256] stacking [img_prev, img_curr, img_next]
• Provides 3D volumetric context without massive 3D-CNN compute overhead.
2. Group Equivariant R2Conv Encoder
• Discrete rotation group C8 (N=8 rotations spaced by 45°)
• Steerable filter banks guarantee f(g • x) = g • f(x)
• Invariant to scanner couch indexing & patient head tilt.
3. Equivariant Bottleneck & Decoder
• Pointwise Max Pooling & Equivariant Group Normalization
• R2Upsampling + skip connection direct sum concatenation
• Preserves fine sub-millimeter tumor boundary details.
4. Projection Head & Advanced Loss
• Equivariant-to-Trivial projection (1x1 conv) -> 2-class softmax
• AdvancedCombinedLoss: L = 2.0*Dice + 0.5*Focal + 0.5*Edge
• Class weighting [1.0, 10.0] tackles extreme foreground/background tumor imbalance.
5. Validated Performance (SOTA)
• Mod-Seg-SE(2) achieves 84.2% Dice & 73.1% IoU on challenging NCCT
• Retains >82% Dice under severe 45°/90°/180° scan rotations.
